title: Purity for a finite normal cover over a depth-two local base
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian normal local domain, with closed point $a\in\operatorname{Spec}A$ (normal means integral domain and integrally closed in its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]; local means it has a unique maximal ideal). Let $q:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be quasi-compact, quasi-separated, smooth with geometrically connected fibres [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $V\subset\operatorname{Spec}A$ be the open whose points are exactly those different from $a$. Let $n:N\to L$ be finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], with every local ring of $N$ a normal domain. Assume the open $n^{-1}(q^{-1}(V))$ is dense in $N$ and $n|_{q^{-1}(V)}$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $W\subset L$ be open and $x\in W$ satisfy $q(x)=a$ and $n|_W$ etale. If $\operatorname{depth}A\ge2$ [def-weil-pbc-depth], then $n$ is etale.

proof.text: Put T=q^{-1}V ∪ W. The private proved helper etale_restrict_sup applies target locality using its two-open cover and the double-restriction isomorphism, giving etaleness of n|_T. Finiteness of the restriction follows by base change. For y not over a, hV places y in q^{-1}V, hence in T.

Smoothness and geometric connectedness imply geometric irreducibility by the proved source-library theorem GeometricallyIrreducible.of_smooth_of_geometricallyConnected (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Regular). Thus the closed fibre is irreducible. Lift x to it with q.fiberHomeo; hx shows the inverse image of T is a nonempty open, hence dense by IsOpen.dense.
Apply exists_finite_etale_extension_of_local_depth_two to q,T and the finite etale restriction n|_T, using haway, hclosed and hdepth. Obtain E,p and e:E|_T ≅ N|_T over T.

The stalks of Spec A are prime localizations of the normal domain A, so they are integrally closed. Apply smooth_connected_generic_geometry_core to q and its canonical generic fibre: it gives IsIntegral L and integrally closed stalks. Nonemptiness is witnessed by x. L is locally Noetherian by its smooth finite-type morphism to Spec A.

Density of n^{-1}(q^{-1}V) implies density of n^{-1}T by inclusion. The open T is nonempty since x belongs to W. Invert e; its equation over T follows by cancellation. Apply finite_normal_iso_of_dense_open_etale_comparison, obtaining i:N ≅ E with i;p=n.
Rewrite n as i.hom;p. Isomorphisms are etale, and etaleness is closed under composition. This proves Etale n without changing its statement.
